## Summary

Use language-aware full-text search configuration for ingested content to improve the lexical side of existing hybrid RRF without regressing established recall.

**Workstream key:** `SOURCE-5`  
**Priority:** P2  
**Parent:** #336  
**Depends on:** #338, #324

## Scope

- Select language-aware FTS configuration from supported corpus metadata or explicit source settings.
- Integrate with existing hybrid retrieval.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] FTS uses an explicit language-aware configuration for the supported corpus languages.
- [ ] Representative lexical queries improve or remain equivalent to the prior default.
- [ ] The EVAL-3 gate shows no regression in hybrid recall metrics across file, drop-folder, and approved conversation fixtures.

## Validation

- [ ] Run focused FTS ranking tests for supported languages.
- [ ] Run EVAL-3 before and after the change and record the metric comparison.

## Non-goals

- Changing embedding models.
- Adding languages not represented by approved corpus requirements.

- Prompt placement stays client/runtime-owned; no implicit MCP `_meta` injection.
- Observability remains content-free.
